providers.title: Nakayama's lemma
providers.scope: A finitely generated module M over a finite-dimensional algebra A with (rad A)M = M is zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The semisimple quotient
providers.scope: A/rad A is semisimple, M/(rad A)M is semisimple for finitely generated M, and every simple module is (A/rad A)e for an idempotent e.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lifting idempotents
providers.scope: Modulo a nilpotent ideal, idempotents lift by an explicit binomial formula.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Projective covers
providers.scope: Every finitely generated module over a finite-dimensional algebra has a projective cover with kernel in the radical.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Projective dimension from the top
providers.scope: For finitely generated N, pd N = sup{i : Tor_i(A/rad A, N) != 0}, computed by a minimal resolution.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A finite presentation
providers.scope: The group with generators T_l, U_i(r), V_i(r), W_ij(r) and relations (G1)-(G5) is finitely presented on fifteen generators.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Central involutions
providers.scope: z_N = [U_i(a), V_i(b)] with a + b = N does not depend on i, a, b, is central, and z_N^2 = 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix quotients
providers.scope: The group maps onto finite subgroups of GL_5(F_2[t]/(t^m - 1)) in which z_0, ..., z_(m-1) are independent central involutions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Selection with unbounded extinction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For R = CG, e = (1 + z_0)/2 and the shift alpha there are finite-dimensional modules Y_m with H^j(Y_m) != 0 for j < m and H^m(Y_m) = 0, where H(Y) is eY twisted by alpha.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Quadratic presentations
providers.scope: Every finitely presented algebra has a presentation whose relations have degree at most two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Directed algebras
providers.scope: A directed algebra with n idempotents has global dimension at most n - 1 on both sides; the three-vertex algebra B has global dimension at most two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The quotient action
providers.scope: In the Verdier quotient by the cones of s and s', x_h -> s^(-1)a_h defines a unital homomorphism from R to the endomorphisms of e_0 B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Evaluation
providers.scope: Tensoring with M(Y) factors through the Verdier quotient and recovers the R-action on Y.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The odd double
providers.scope: For an idempotent of an object of a triangulated category with image U in the idempotent completion, U + U[1] and U + U[3] are isomorphic to objects of the category.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A diagram for the selection
providers.scope: A fixed B-diagram in the Verdier quotient evaluates at every Y to eY + (eY)[3], with the arrows acting through alpha.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Diagram lifting
providers.scope: Every B-diagram in the Verdier quotient is isomorphic to the image of a B-diagram in the homotopy category.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fixed lifted diagram
providers.scope: Complexes D_i, chain maps f_a and homotopies h_rho, chosen before Y, whose evaluation at every Y is the selection diagram.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The three-column complex
providers.scope: The arrows, the maps f_a and the homotopies h_rho form one bounded complex P of B-bimodules, projective on the right.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Vertices
providers.scope: Each D_i is homotopy equivalent to e_i P.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Realization of selection (OpenAI)
providers.scope: P (x)^L_B M(Y) = M(H(Y)) + M(H(Y))[3] in D(B) for every finite-dimensional R-module Y.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Iterates
providers.scope: The j-th iterate of P (x)^L_B - on M(Y) is a sum of binomially many shifts of M(H^j(Y)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ordinary simulation (OpenAI)
providers.scope: D = B x (B (x) C) has finite global dimension, and two steps of F = X (x)^L_D - on the first factor are P[b_*] (x)^L_B -.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Even iterates
providers.scope: F^(2j) M(Y) is a sum of shifts of M(H^j(Y)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bar decomposition (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For a D-module N inflated to the trivial extension A = D x X, D (x)^L_A N is the sum over r of (F^r N)[r].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Detecting projective dimension (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If D has finite global dimension on both sides: F^t N = 0 gives pd_A N finite, and F^r N != 0 gives pd_A N >= r.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Infinite little finitistic dimension (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A finite-dimensional complex algebra A with modules N_m satisfying 2m - 2 <= pd N_m < infinity; findim A = Findim A = infinity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Left-right asymmetry (OpenAI, under named results)
providers.scope: Under the named statements (CUM), (RIC) and (MOR): an algebra with both finitistic dimensions infinite on the left and zero on the right.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
